messages:
laura: Quick q — manager submitted an out-of-cycle comp increase (about 10% for an IC moving into new responsibilities). What's the ad-hoc approval flow? what docs do they need to attach?
omar: For hiring-ops side: manager fills the comp-change form and pings their manager for approval. attach the evidence doc and cost code. link: https://redwood-internal/forms/comp-change
ben: Finance checklist: ECD (expected change date), annual run-rate delta, cost center, and justification. we also need People Ops signoff before payroll. if >$12k/yr run-rate, route to Director+ and Finance review.
maria: I already filled the form but it asks for "sign-off matrix" — who signs when the band increase crosses grade boundaries?
samuel: If bump crosses formal grade you need manager -> manager's manager -> People Ops. thresholds: >$12k director signoff; >$25k exec signoff. include promo evidence (bullet list of responsibilities + examples).
maria: And is this done in Workday or via the form + manual attachments? manager is confused about where to upload docs.
omar: The intake is the form (it creates a Workday task). Attach evidence to the form and also drop a copy in the Workday request. For urgent cases add "PRIORITY" in the subject and ping @people-ops-review in Slack.
laura: One more Q — manager asked whether we allow retroactive pay (backpay) to employee start date of new role?
ben: Retro pay is exceptional. require CFO approval and People Ops signoff. Finance prefers retro <= 60 days. bigger than that needs strong justification and will be escalated.
maria: We're trying to get this live for the next payroll (target Apr 30). realistic?
samuel: If the form + approvals are complete today, Finance can usually make next payroll, but plan for ~10 business days. include the cost code and the HRIS employee ID to avoid delays.
maria: Got it. Separate Q: equity refresh — do we combine that with comp change request?
laura: Equity is a separate workflow handled by comp-ops. do not mix in the comp-change form. I'll ping comp-ops for Maria.
jen-bot: Automated checklist: 1) Comp-change form submitted (https://redwood-internal/forms/comp-change) 2) Manager rationale + evidence doc attached 3) Manager manager approval 4) Finance allocation and cost code 5) People Ops signoff 6) Add priority tag if time-sensitive. See playbook: https://redwood-internal/playbooks/comp-change
omar: I'll DM you the form walkthrough, Maria. @samuel do we have a short evidence template?
samuel: Use "promo-evidence-template-v2" in Drive (I'll post the link to #docs in a bit). includes bullets for scope, impact, customers, examples.
maria: Thank you all — will resubmit with evidence and priority flag. :heart:
laura: Awesome. tagging this for follow-up: if anyone hits blockers reply here and we'll coordinate.
